request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBACT04C-002: The last account group is never written back at end of file

### given[0]: END-OF-FILE starts as 'N'.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   133        01  APPL-RESULT             PIC S9(9)   COMP.
   134            88  APPL-AOK            VALUE 0.
   135            88  APPL-EOF            VALUE 16.
   136 
>> 137        01  END-OF-FILE             PIC X(01)    VALUE 'N'.
   138        01  ABCODE                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.
   139        01  TIMING                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.
   140       * T I M E S T A M P   D B 2  X(26)     EEEE-MM-DD-UU.MM.SS.HH0000
   141        01  COBOL-TS.

### given[1]: The main loop repeats until END-OF-FILE = 'Y', and the test is made before each pass. Inside the loop, the ELSE branch that performs the account update is taken only when END-OF-FILE is not 'N' at the top of a pass.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['Y', 'N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   184            PERFORM 0200-DISCGRP-OPEN.
   185            PERFORM 0300-ACCTFILE-OPEN.
   186            PERFORM 0400-TRANFILE-OPEN.
   187 
>> 188            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
>> 189                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
>> 190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
>> 191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'

### given[2]: The ELSE branch would perform the account update.
fields=[] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
   216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
   217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
>> 219                ELSE
>> 220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
>> 221                END-IF
>> 222            END-PERFORM.
   223 
   224            PERFORM 9000-TCATBALF-CLOSE.
   225            PERFORM 9100-XREFFILE-CLOSE.
   226            PERFORM 9200-DISCGRP-CLOSE.

### given[3]: For each record of the last account with a non-zero rate, interest is computed and an interest transaction is written during the loop.
fields=['DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
   212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
   213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
>> 214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
>> 215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
>> 216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
>> 217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
   219                ELSE
   220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   221                END-IF

### when[0]: Reading the category balance file returns status '10' (end of file), which sets APPL-RESULT to 16.
fields=['TCATBALF-STATUS', 'APPL-RESULT'] literals=['10', '16']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   326            READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD.
   327            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '00'
   328                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   329            ELSE
>> 330                IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '10'
>> 331                    MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT
   332                ELSE
   333                    MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT
   334                END-IF
   335            END-IF

### when[1]: APPL-EOF (APPL-RESULT value 16) causes END-OF-FILE to be set to 'Y'.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['Y']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   335            END-IF
   336            IF  APPL-AOK
   337                CONTINUE
   338            ELSE
>> 339                IF  APPL-EOF
>> 340                    MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE
   341                ELSE
   342                    DISPLAY 'ERROR READING TRANSACTION CATEGORY FILE'
   343                    MOVE TCATBALF-STATUS TO IO-STATUS
   344                    PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS

### then[0]: The inner check END-OF-FILE = 'N' is now false, so nothing more is done in that pass. The loop then stops at its next test, so the ELSE branch's account update never runs.
fields=['END-OF-FILE'] literals=['N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   187 
   188            PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'
   189                IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
>> 191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'

### then[1]: As a result, the last account group's WS-TOTAL-INT is never added to ACCT-CURR-BAL, its cycle credit and debit are not zeroed, and its account record is not rewritten. If the file is empty, no account is updated at all.
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT', 'ACCT-CURR-BAL', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   348            EXIT.
   349       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   350        1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT.
   351       * Update the balances in account record to reflect posted trans.
>> 352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
>> 353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
>> 355 
>> 356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
   357            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   358                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   359            ELSE
   360                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 137 declares END-OF-FILE PIC X(01) with VALUE 'N'."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 188 is a PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y', which tests before each pass by default, and line 189 gates the read branch on END-OF-FILE = 'N', so the alternative path applies only when it is not 'N'."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 219-220 show the ELSE branch performing 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT."},{"clause":"given[3]","supported":false,"reason":"Lines 214-217 only show 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST and 1400-COMPUTE-FEES being performed when DIS-INT-RATE is non-zero; they do not show that an interest transaction is written, nor anything specific to the last account's records."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 330-331 move 16 to APPL-RESULT when TCATBALF-STATUS = '10'."},{"clause":"when[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 339-340 move 'Y' to END-OF-FILE when APPL-EOF is true."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":false,"reason":"Line 191 only shows the inner END-OF-FILE = 'N' test; the claims that the loop stops at its next test and that the ELSE update never runs depend on lines 188-189 and 219-220, which are not cited."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 352-356 show what 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT does (add WS-TOTAL-INT to ACCT-CURR-BAL, zero cycle credit/debit, rewrite the record), which is exactly what is described as being skipped."}]}
